tagline: Every branch of your work, in one calm stream.

missing.title: Install Git to continue
missing.macos: Install the Xcode Command Line Tools by running xcode-select --install in Terminal, or install Git with Homebrew.
missing.windows: Download and run the Git for Windows installer.
missing.linux: Install Git with your distribution's package manager, for example sudo apt install git.
missing.customPath: If Git is installed in an unusual place, set the GARAM_GIT_PATH environment variable to its full path.
